content.context: Running the export twice in a row to prove the restore point supersedes its predecessor instead of leaving a conflicting duplicate.
content.decision: Supersede prior restore points for the same project and commit, using the new record as evidence.
content.rationale: Each export used to write a fresh restore point, so pitmry context reported CONFLICT on the next query.
